articles.text: MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Wǒ lái, wǒ lái! Děngyiděng, wǒ lái bāng ni kāi mén.
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: I'll get it, I'll get it. Wait a second, I'll open the door for you.
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Xièxie ni.
CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: Thank you.
MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Zhè dōu shi nǐ jiède shū a?
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: These are all books you borrowed?
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Shì a! Yòngle liǎngge xīngqīde gōngfu, hǎo róngyi cái kànwán le.
CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: Yeah! It took me long enough to finish reading them--two weeks!
MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Bú cuò, liǎngge xīngqī kàn zhème duō Yīngwén cānkǎoshū, sùdù bù màn na!
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: Not bad! To read all these English reference books in two weeks, that's a pretty good speed!
MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Xiūxi jǐfēn zhōng zài jìnqu kàn shū, hǎo bu hǎo a?
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: Why don't you rest a few minutes before you go in to study, okay?
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Hǎo. Nèitian, xìli yánjiūshēng kāi huì, dàjiā dōu rènwéi nǐ tánde hěn hǎo, yě dōu juéde nǐde Zhōngwén bǐ gāng lái Běidàde shíhou hǎode duō le.

CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: Okay. The other day when the graduate students in the department held a meeting, everyone thought that what you said was very good, and we all felt that your Chinese is much better now than when you first came to B.U.
MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Kěshi wǒ háishi juéde xuéxí sùdù tài màn, wǒmen dōu xīwang néng jiākuài sùdù, tígāo shuō huàde shuǐpíng.
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: But I still feel that our pace of study is too slow. We all wish we could speed up the pace to improve our speaking.

ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Nèitiān nǐ tíchulaide guānyú yào liǎojiě Zhōngguó shèhuìde wèntí, xuéxiào fāngmiàn yídìng huì kǎolǜde. Kěshi wǒ xiǎng, nǐmen shuō Zhōngwénde jīhui bù shǎo a! Yǒu Zhōngguó lǎoshī, yǒu Zhōngguó tóngxué, érqiě nǐmende Zhōngwén dōu bú cuò le, nǐmen wàiguó xuésheng zìjǐ yě kěyi shuō Zhōngwén ma!

CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: I'm sure the school will consider the question you brought up about wanting to learn about Chinese society. But it seems to me you have plenty of chances to speak Chinese! There are the Chinese teachers, and your Chinese classmates. And your Chinese is good enough now that you foreign students can speak Chinese among yourselves!
MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Wǒmen zìjǐ zài yìqǐ shuō Yīngwén shi hěn zìránde. Érqiě, xuéxiàoli dōu shi xuésheng hé lǎoshī, wǒmen hěn xīwang hé shèhuìshangde pǔtōng rén tányitán.
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: It's natural for us to speak English together. Besides, in school it's all students and teachers. We want very much to converse with ordinary people in society.
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Wǒmen zhèixiē xuésheng duōbànr yě dōu shi cóng pǔtōngde jiātíngli láide ma.
CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: Most of us students are from ordinary families, you know.
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Tèbié shi jīngguò Wénhuà Dà Gémìng yǐhòude dàxuéshēng duōbànr dōu zài shèhuìshang gōngzuòguo hěn duō nián, bǐjiào liǎojiě shèhuìde qíngkuàng.
CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: In particular, most college students after the Cultural Revolution have worked in society many years and understand the social situation pretty well.

MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Ō, zhè hái shi yǒu qūbiéde. Shèhuìde qíngkuàng gēn dàxuélǐde qíngkuàng hěn bù yíyàng. Wǒmen lái Zhōngguó niàn shūde wàiguó liúxuéshēng, yánjiūshēng, dōu hěn xiǎng duō liǎojiě Zhōngguóde qíngxing, tèbié shi xiǎng liǎojiě nǐmen shíxiàn Sìge Xiàndàihuàde qíngkuàng.

AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: Oh, there's still a difference. The situation in society is very different from the situation in the university. All of us foreign college and graduate students who come to China to study want to understand the situation here, and especially how the accomplishment of the Four Modernizations is progressing.
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Dāngrán, dāngrán. Zhèi yìdiǎn wǒmen shi qīngchude. Wǒmen xiǎng tài duōde shèhuì huódòng dàgài huì làngfèi nǐmen bù shǎode shíjiān.
CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: Of course, of course. We understand that. But we think that too many social activities would probably waste a lot of your time.
MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Ō! Méiyou wèntí, zài Měiguóde dàxuéli, wǒmen bù jiù shi zài xuéxiào hé túshūguǎnli niàn shū, shèhuì shēnghuó shi wǒmen zuì zhòngyàode jiàokēshū, yě shi zuì hǎode lǎoshī.
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: Oh, that's no problem. In American universities, we don't just study in school and in the library. Social life is our most important textbook and our best teacher.
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Hǎode, hǎode, wǒ yídìng hé xìli tányitán, duō gěi nǐmen ānpái diǎnr cānguān fǎngwènde huódòng.
CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: All right, I'll be sure to talk with the department, and set up more visiting activities for you people.
MĚIGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Hǎode, xièxie ni. Nǐ kuài jìnqu niàn shū ba! Bù zhàn nǐde shíjiān le. Zàijiàn.
AMERICAN GRADUATE STUDENT: Good, thank you. Now you go on in and study. I won't take up any more of your time. Good-bye.
ZHŌNGGUÓ YÁNJIŪSHĒNG: Zàijiàn.
CHINESE GRADUATE STUDENT: Good-bye.
